rows.text: On 7 November 1990 the Prime Minister, Shri Vishwanath Pratap Singh, moves in the Lok Sabha that the House expresses its confidence in the Council of Ministers; the Speaker records the motion as moved.

locator.item: Motion of Confidence in the Council of Ministers; 'THE PRIME MINISTER (SHRI VISHWANATH PRATAP SINGH): Sir, I beg to move'; 'MR. SPEAKER: Motion moved'

rows.text: The confidence motion moved by Shri Vishwanath Pratap Singh is put to a division (Division No. 1, 22.22 hrs); subject to correction the result is Ayes 142, Noes 346, and the motion is negatived. The House is then adjourned sine die.

locator.item: 'The Lok Sabha divided'; 'Ayes : 142 / Noes : 346 / The motion was negatived'
